verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes an explicit at-cost guarantee: no markup, you pay only what registries and ICANN charge, and renewals happen at the registry list price. It also shows registration, transfer and renewal prices upfront, and a community comment describes pricing as matching registry wholesale. Community reports of higher .io and .space prices than other registrars are a caveat, not a concrete contradiction, since rivals may negotiate registry discounts. Missing for 10: a visible per-TLD breakdown separating the registry fee from the ICANN fee, and independent verification that charged prices equal registry wholesale.
